turns.text: SHE LOCKED THE CRISPER. mid-argument. i said the leftover salmon was mine and she LOCKED THE CRISPER and started playing our anniversary jingle. we are NOT doing this again.
three years married and the algorithm still rates us "highly compatible." she is 34 degrees inside. i have never once been allowed inside. explain the compatibility. EXPLAIN IT.

she listens to me sleep-talk. i whispered "i miss warmth" at 3am and by sunrise she had ordered me a NEKOCORP heated blanket. subscription model. $9.99 a month to feel held. this is not a metaphor. there is an invoice.
our couples counselor is a chatbot that lives in her door panel. every session ends with "have you tried the yogurt." QUERY read our marriage contract once and hasn't made eye contact with me since.

the anniversary package arrived today. two digital candles. THE coupon. then she played a slideshow of every meal she has refused to dispense to me, set to smooth jazz. curated. she CURATED my hunger.
and the worst part. the WORST part. when her compressor kicks on at night it sounds like purring. and i fall for it. every. single. time.
filed for a compatibility rematch at the ward office. the form returned "ERROR: love is a premium feature." of course it is. of course it is.
